newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWISS BOND MARKET CLOSING REPORT.
newsitem.headline: SWISS BOND MARKET CLOSING REPORT.

text.p: Swiss bonds were firm at the end of trade, despite rising short-term rates which also left bonds expensive relative to swaps, traders said.
Demand centered on the longer maturities, with prices seen supported by lack of liquidity.

The Swiss National Bank said with release of its 10-day reserves statement on Monday that the level of sight deposits, reported at roughly 3.9 billion Swiss francs on August 8, relected a continued generous supply of liquidity to the Swiss money market. The SNB's policy was continuing in view of the weak German mark.
Conf futures up 17 basis points at 120.07.
Euro Swiss francs down one at 98.43.
